 Sources: Jensen Huang had an intimate relationship with a second employee; revelations about two other extramarital affairs led to his resignation   —  Ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an intimate relationship with a second employee, according to two people familiar with the matter, Reuters has learned.
